name: container_contents
description: Show the slots of any one thing in the world and what is in them, nested: a locker, crate, machine, suit, backpack, or 'player' for the local player's whole inventory. Works whether or not the thing is on a data network. position and distance_m are where the thing is in the world: for a thing in a slot, its outermost holder's (a stored item keeps no position of its own). Read only; no gateway is needed.

reference_id.description: Reference ID of any thing (from find_items, list_containers or list_devices), or 'player' for the local player.

depth.description: How many levels of nested slots to show, default 3.
